headline: San Francisco Fed President Daly Says Additional Rate Hikes May Be Needed
summary: San Francisco Federal Reserve President Mary Daly stated that further monetary policy tightening could be required to bring persistent inflation back down to the US central bank's target.
why: Federal Reserve officials' public commentary shapes interest rate expectations and global asset pricing.

impacts.name: US 10-Year Treasury Yield
impacts.why: Hawkish Fed commentary raises fixed income yields on expectations of elevated benchmark rates.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Hawkish interest rate signals from a regional Fed leader pressured rate-sensitive equities and elevated bond yields.
